corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Matthew 21:3 and visual inspection show 7th-order ኦ in 'እግዚኦሙ' ('their Lord', translated as 'ጌታቸው' on L25), not 'እግዚእሙ'.
Both the printed glyph and Amharic grammar ('ይደርስ ይፈጸም ዘንድ ነው') clearly show 6th-order ይ ('ይደርስ'), not ያ ('ያደርስ').
The printed glyph in the image is 6th-order ጭ ('ከውርንጭዋ'), not 4th-order ጫ.
Both the printed glyph and traditional Andemta wartime imagery ('በፈረስ ተቀምጠው ዘገር ነጥቀው ይታያሉ', contrasting with peacetime 'መነሳንስ ይዘው') clearly read 'ዘገር' (spear/javelin), not 'ነገር'.
Causative perfect verb 'አናግሯል' (he caused to speak / inspired the prophecy) begins with 1st-order አ, matching the printed glyph.
This is the first half of the wrapped Amharic causative verb 'አስመ↵ስሏል' (he caused the typology to be enacted, parallel to 'አናግሯል' on L28), beginning with 1st-order አ and wrapping mid-word to L30.
In the Ge'ez citation 'አላ ከመ እንተ አድግ ነፍስትክሙ' (correlating with the 2nd person pronoun 'አንተ' on L35), the printed glyphs are 'ትክ' ('ነፍስትክሙ'), which were misread as 'ቶ'.
Both the printed glyph (with the upper-right loop of 7th-order ኖ) and Amharic grammar require 'እኖ↵ራለሁ' ('I dwell/live in them'), not 'እናራለሁ'.
